description_en: Queries the details of a global database network (GDN)
description_zh: 查询全球数据库网络（GDN）详情
name: DescribeGlobalDatabaseNetwork

Port.description_en: The port number of the connection string

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the GDN was created.

The time is in the ISO 8601 format in UTC (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
CreateTime.description_zh:
GDN的创建时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

Category.description_en:
The edition of the product. Valid values:

Normal: Cluster Edition
Basic: Single Node Edition
Archive: PolarDB X-Engine Edition
NormalMultimaster: Multi-master Cluster Edition
SENormal: PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition

PolarDB for PostgreSQL 11 does not support Single Node Edition.
PolarDB for MySQL 8.0, PolarDB for MySQL 5.7, and PolarDB for PostgreSQL 14 support PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition.
PolarDB for MySQL 8.0 supports PolarDB X-Engine Edition and Multi-master Cluster Edition
Category.description_zh:
产品系列，取值范围如下：

Normal：集群版
Basic：单节点
Archive：高压缩引擎（X-Engine）
NormalMultimaster：多主架构集群版
SENormal：标准版

PolarDB PostgreSQL 版 PostgreSQL 11 版本不支持单节点。
PolarDB MySQL 版 8.0 版本、5.7 版本，PolarDB PostgreSQL 版 PostgreSQL 14 版本支持标准版。
PolarDB MySQL 版 8.0 版本，支持高压缩引擎（X-Engine）和多主架构集群版

DBClusterId.description_en: The cluster ID in the GDN

DBClusterStatus.description_en: The status of the cluster in the GDN. For more information, see [Cluster status table]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99286.html）
DBClusterStatus.description_zh: GDN中的集群状态。具体请参见[集群状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99286.html）

DBNodeClass.description_en: The node specifications of the database node

DBNodes.description_en: The details of the database nodes
DBNodes.description_zh: 数据库节点的信息详情

CreationTime.description_en:
The time when the database node was created.

The time is in the ISO 8601 format in UTC (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
CreationTime.description_zh:
数据库节点的创建时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

DBNodeClass.description_en: The node specifications of the database node

DBNodeRole.description_en:
The role of the database node. Valid values:

Writer: primary node

Reader: read-only node
DBNodeRole.description_zh:
数据库节点的角色。取值：

Writer：主节点

Reader：只读节点

DBNodeStatus.description_en:
The status of the node. Valid values:

Creating: Being created.

Running: Running.

Deleting: Being deleted.

Rebooting: Being restarted.

ClassChanging: The node specifications are being changed.

NetAddressCreating: Network connectivity is being created.

NetAddressDeleting: Network connectivity is being deleted.

NetAddressModifying: Network connectivity is being modified.

MinorVersionUpgrading: A minor engine version upgrade is in progress.

Maintaining: The cluster is under maintenance.

Switching: A failover is in progress
DBNodeStatus.description_zh:
节点状态。取值：

Creating：创建中

Running：运行中

Deleting：删除中

Rebooting：重启中

ClassChanging：正在变更节点规格

NetAddressCreating：正在创建网络连接

NetAddressDeleting：正在删除网络连接

NetAddressModifying：正在修改网络连接

MinorVersionUpgrading：小版本升级中

Maintaining：集群维护中

Switching：切换中

FailoverPriority.description_en: The failover priority. Each node has a failover priority that determines the likelihood of the node being elected as the primary node during a failover. A higher value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 15
FailoverPriority.description_zh: Failover优先级。每个节点都有一个Failover优先级，决定了当故障切换时，该节点被选举为主节点的概率高低。数值越大，优先级越高，取值范围为1~15

MaxConnections.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent connections to the cluster
MaxConnections.description_zh: 集群最大的并发连接数

MaxIOPS.description_en: The maximum number of I/O requests per second (IOPS)

DBType.description_en: The database engine type. Currently, only MySQL is supported
DBType.description_zh: 数据库引擎类型。当前仅支持MySQL类型

DBVersion.description_en: The database engine version. Currently, only version 8.0 is supported
DBVersion.description_zh: 数据库引擎版本。当前仅支持8.0版本

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster.

This parameter is returned only for clusters whose billing method is Prepaid (subscription). An empty value is returned for Postpaid (pay-as-you-go) clusters.

The time is in the ISO 8601 format in UTC (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
ExpireTime.description_zh:
集群到期时间。

仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群会返回具体参数值，Postpaid（按量付费）集群则返回空值。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true

false

This parameter is returned only for clusters whose billing method is Prepaid (subscription)
Expired.description_zh:
集群是否到期。

true：是

false：否

仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群支持返回该参数

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型：

Postpaid：按量付费。

Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）

ReplicaLag.description_en: The cross-region replication delay between the primary and secondary clusters. Unit: seconds
ReplicaLag.description_zh: 主从集群间跨地域的复制延迟时间。单位为秒

Role.description_en:
The role of the cluster. Valid values:

primary: primary cluster

standby: secondary cluster

A GDN contains one primary cluster and up to four secondary clusters
Role.description_zh:
集群角色。取值：

primary：主集群

standby：从集群

一个GDN中包含一个主集群和最多四个从集群

ServerlessType.description_en:
The serverless type. The value is fixed as AgileServerless.
This parameter is supported only for serverless clusters
ServerlessType.description_zh:
Serverless类型。当前取值固定为AgileServerless（敏态）。
仅Serverless集群支持该参数

StorageUsed.description_zh: 存储空间的使用量，单位为Byte

DBType.description_en: The database engine type. Currently, only MySQL is supported
DBType.description_zh: 数据库引擎类型。当前仅支持MySQL类型

DBVersion.description_en: The database engine version. Currently, only version 8.0 is supported
DBVersion.description_zh: 数据库引擎版本。当前仅支持8.0版本

GDNDescription.description_en:
The description of the GDN. The description must meet the following requirements:

It cannot start with http:// or https://.

It must start with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, or a Chinese character.

It can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

It must be 2 to 126 characters in length
GDNDescription.description_zh:
GDN备注描述。要求如下：

不能以http://或https://开头。

必须以大小写字母或中文开头。

可以包含大小写字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）或连字符（-）。

长度为2~126个字符

GDNStatus.description_en:
The status of the GDN. Valid values:

creating: Being created.

active: Running.

deleting: Being deleted.

locked: Locked. No operations can be performed on any cluster in the GDN.

removing_member: A cluster is being removed from the GDN
GDNStatus.description_zh:
GDN的状态。取值：

creating：创建中

active：运行中

deleting：删除中

locked：锁定中（此时无法对GDN下的任一集群执行任何操作）

removing_member：从集群正在脱离GDN
